help.workspace: This workspace is the trust decision layer, not a duplicate source of truth for orders or payments. Sensitive actions reuse canonical services and are audited.
help.openCases: Cases that have not reached a final resolution.
help.highCases: Open high or severe risk cases.
help.decisions: Decisions recorded in the last 30 days; effects are stored separately in the action ledger.
help.signals: Normalized trust signals recorded in the last 30 days.
help.activeEnforcement: Active enforcement actions affecting checkout or the canonical order state machine.
help.preventedLoss: Sum of prevented_loss_minor from recorded outcomes only; unknown when outcomes are missing.
help.falsePositive: False-positive outcomes divided by labeled outcomes in the last 30 days.
help.outcomeCoverage: Recorded outcomes divided by decisions in the last 30 days.
help.attention: Highest-priority unresolved cases by risk score and freshness.
help.distribution: Decision action distribution for the last 30 days.
help.patterns: Most frequent recorded signal types in the last 30 days.
help.friction: Adaptive friction: trusted is frictionless, low/medium monitored, elevated stepped-up, high held/reviewed and severe blocked by policy.
help.caseQueue: Each row is a real case with subject, risk, recommendation, SLA, owner and optimistic version.
help.riskScore: Risk score is 0–100 and is not a guaranteed probability of fraud.
help.confidence: Confidence reflects evidence strength and is distinct from risk score.
help.falsePositiveRisk: Shown only when supported by measured data.
help.evidence: Evidence is snapshotted for later review; sensitive references are permission-gated.
help.decision: A decision is separate from its external side effect, which is recorded idempotently in the action ledger.
help.override: Overrides require a reason, step-up authentication and strict audit logging.
help.appeal: Appeal reopens a case without deleting prior history.
help.outcome: Outcomes close the measurement loop for false positives, losses and policy/model quality.
help.graph: Only recorded edges are shown; inferred edges are explicitly labeled and never presented as verified facts.
help.graphDepth: Graph depth is capped at three hops to bound fan-out.
help.policy: Policies are immutable versions. Activating a new version retires the previous active version of the same key.
help.policySimulation: The simulator is dry-run only and causes no side effects.
help.access: Backend permissions are enforced through tenant-scoped admin_permissions; presets write those real permissions.
help.signalLedger: Signals retain source, subject, risk, confidence, privacy class, versions and event/receive times.
help.scan: The scan reads canonical ledgers and writes idempotent signals; it never duplicates order/refund truth.
help.automation: Automation should distinguish approved agents, unknown automation and abusive bots; no category is fabricated without evidence.
help.modelRegistry: Every model version records owner, features, privacy controls, evaluation, calibration, limitations and rollback.
help.rollout: Rollout is the allowed traffic percentage for a version and requires step-up plus audit when changed.
help.modelQuality: Quality metrics are calculated only from labeled outcomes.
help.freshness: Shows when the decision view was generated and which sources contributed.
